title_zh: 确认小岛旅馆抵达及停航联络安排

scenario.label_zh: 核对小岛旅馆的抵达与停航联络
scenario.goal_zh: 确认码头会合地点，并约定旅客先核对班次、遇停航时致电旅馆

context_zh: 旅客给英国离岛上的小旅馆打电话，确认第二天的抵达安排。
author: author-phase08-a

sentences.speaker: Tom
sentences.text: Your directions say to meet you at the harbour. Is there more than one landing place?

sentences.speaker: Fiona
sentences.text: There's just one passenger pier. I'll meet the afternoon boat beside the small shelter.

sentences.speaker: Tom
sentences.text: The island looks quite isolated. What happens if that boat is cancelled?

sentences.speaker: Fiona
sentences.text: Call us before you leave the mainland. Don't book another crossing without checking where it arrives.

sentences.speaker: Tom
sentences.text: A former inhabitant of the island told me there used to be a second ferry.

sentences.speaker: Fiona
sentences.text: There was, but it doesn't run now. Use the service named in your booking email.

sentences.speaker: Tom
sentences.text: All right. I'll check the operator's update in the morning and call if anything changes.

sentences.speaker: Fiona
sentences.text: And if it runs as planned, I'll see you at the pier.

targets.sense_zh: 供船只停泊的港口（英式拼写）
